description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds; FIXED in 0.17.6: the black band as tall as the bar that stayed at the bottom of the Reels tab is gone — the tab pager's own bottom padding, which Facebook sets to the bar's height, is lifted while the bar is hidden, so reels reach the bottom of the screen and the progress bar rests on the video's bottom edge) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open on Reels, FIXED in 0.17.5 (0.17.4 capped only the ratio and changed nothing on a phone; 0.17.5 also caps the sheet's pixel sizes where they are worked out; on by default, settings > Comments) + the 0.17.4 switches now have Vietnamese names and summaries + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance); quiet preset.
